description: Permanently delete 1 to 100 carts with their analytics events, the visitor sessions only they used and any discount use they held (the code's use count goes back down). All or nothing: an id that is not a cart of this workspace, or a cart already turned into an order (status ordered - anonymize the order instead), refuses the whole call and deletes nothing. Returns how many carts were deleted. Cannot be undone.
name: delete_carts
title: Delete carts
